levels.0: assembly: entrypoints and wiring allowed to reference any layer
levels.1: foundation services: platform capabilities and operations domains
levels.2: window containers and the embedded browser domain

notes: A file with no matching prefix has no layer constraint; the check reports mapped coverage so gaps stay visible.
Level 0 files are exempt from layer rules in both directions.
Level 2 entries may declare domain and allowedDomains; level 2 to level 2 edges are only allowed when the target domain is listed.
The operations domain (updates, diagnostics) stays physically in place; prefixes record its level only.
